translations.idiomatic: Gao Longzhi slandered Youdao with words of disloyalty; the crime merited death.

sentences.zh: 給事黃門侍郎楊愔曰：「畜狗求吠；

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Yang Yin said, "One keeps a dog to make it bark;
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Yang Yin said, "One keeps a dog to make it bark;

sentences.zh: 今以數吠殺之，恐將來無復吠狗。

translations.literal: now you kill it for barking a few times—I fear hereafter there will be no dog left to bark.
translations.idiomatic: now you kill it for barking a few times—I fear hereafter there will be no dog left to bark."

sentences.zh: 」游道竟坐除名。

translations.literal: " Youdao was punished by removal from office in the end.
translations.idiomatic: Youdao was punished by removal from office in the end.

sentences.zh: 澄謂游道曰：「卿早從我向并州，不爾，彼經略殺卿。

translations.literal: Cheng told Youdao, "If you had followed me early to Bingzhou it would not have been so; otherwise Longzhi would have killed you.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng told Youdao, "If you had followed me early to Bingzhou it would not have been so; otherwise Longzhi would have killed you."

sentences.zh: 」游道從澄至晉陽，以為大行台吏部。

translations.literal: " Youdao followed Cheng to Jinyang and was made Personnel Director of the Grand Eastern Office.
translations.idiomatic: Youdao followed Cheng to Jinyang and was made Personnel Director of the Grand Eastern Office.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大赦。

translations.literal: On jichou, a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 東魏以喪亂之後，戶口失實，徭賦不均。

translations.literal: After the disorders Eastern Wei's household registers no longer matched reality and corvée and tax were uneven.
translations.idiomatic: After the disorders Eastern Wei's household registers no longer matched reality and corvée and tax were uneven.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，丁巳，以太保孫騰、大司徒高隆之為括戶大使，分行諸州，得無籍之戶六十餘萬，僑居者皆勒還本屬。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on dingsi, Grand Guardian Sun Teng and Grand Minister of Works Gao Longzhi were made commissioners for registering households, touring the provinces separately; they obtained more than six hundred thousand households without registers, and all who had moved away were compelled to return to their original jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on dingsi, Grand Guardian Sun Teng and Grand Minister of Works Gao Longzhi were made commissioners for registering households, touring the provinces separately; they obtained more than six hundred thousand households without registers, and all who had moved away were compelled to return to their original jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 十一月，甲申，以高隆之錄尚書事，以前大司馬婁昭為司徒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiashen, Gao Longzhi was made Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and former Grand Marshal Lou Zhao Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiashen, Gao Longzhi was made Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and former Grand Marshal Lou Zhao Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚子，東魏主祀圜丘。

translations.literal: On gengzi the Eastern Wei ruler sacrificed at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Eastern Wei ruler sacrificed at the Round Mound.

sentences.zh: 東魏丞相歡襲擊山胡，破之，俘萬餘戶，分配諸州。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei Chancellor Huan raided the Mountain Hu, defeated them, captured more than ten thousand households, and distributed them among the provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei Chancellor Huan raided the Mountain Hu, defeated them, captured more than ten thousand households, and distributed them among the provinces.

sentences.zh: 是歲，東魏以散騎常侍魏收兼中書侍郎，修國史。

translations.literal: That year Eastern Wei made Acting Palace Attendant Wei Shou also Secretariat Attendant to compile the national history.
translations.idiomatic: That year Eastern Wei made Acting Palace Attendant Wei Shou also Secretariat Attendant to compile the national history.

sentences.zh: 自梁、魏通好，魏書每云：「想彼境內寧靜，此率土安和。

translations.literal: Since Liang and Wei were on good terms, Wei letters always said, "We trust your realm is tranquil within; our whole land is at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Since Liang and Wei were on good terms, Wei letters always said, "We trust your realm is tranquil within; our whole land is at peace."

sentences.zh: 」上復書，去「彼」字而已。

translations.literal: " The emperor in reply removed only the word "your.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in reply removed only the word "your."

sentences.zh: 收始定書云：「想境內清晏，今萬里安和。

translations.literal: Shou first fixed the letter to read, "We trust the realm is clear and calm; now ten thousand li are at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Shou first fixed the letter to read, "We trust the realm is clear and calm; now ten thousand li are at peace."

sentences.zh: 」上亦效之。

translations.literal: " The emperor imitated that as well.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor imitated that as well.
